correctness.rationale: Binary table (TP,FP,FN,TN) all strictly positive and TP*TN>FP*FN, same N and same actual prevalence P across compared classifiers. Writing Q=N-P,R=TP+FP,S=N-R,Delta=TP*TN-FP*FN gives MCC=Delta/sqrt(PQRS) and kappa=2Delta/(PS+QR). These exact formulas were rederived; positive signs make squared MCC comparisons order-preserving. Complete independent enumeration of positive-Delta tables and all unordered pairs by N,P from N=4 through 12 used integer cross-products for squared MCC and exact rational kappa: no weak disagreement for N<=9, 4 weak-only differences at N10, none at N11, and exactly 2 strict reversals (class-complements) at N12. Through N11, 382 eligible pairs checked. N10 P3: A=(1,1,2,6),B=(2,3,1,4), MCC ties 1/sqrt21, kappas 4/19>1/5. N12 P4: (2,3,2,5) kappa2/17 MCC1/sqrt70 vs (3,5,1,3) kappa1/10 MCC1/8: strictly opposite. Finite exhaustion is valid because claim quantifies only 4<=N<=12 for minimal boundary.
